note: Conditional adjustments applied after the product type is matched. cues are lower-case whole words or phrases (a trailing plural s also matches) looked for in product, audience and mood. set changes a default only when the brief did not set that field itself; direction is preferred ahead of the product's own pair, still subject to must_avoid and mode. Every applied modifier is reported as an info finding.

modifiers.note: nothing to sell yet: one email field, no pricing, no invented signup counts

avoid: playful illustration on security and pricing pages
modifiers.note: buyers need evidence before a form; certifications must link to something verifiable
the public page exists to get the app installed; badges in the first screen
quality is signalled by space and restraint; check thin light text against the background

avoid: animated number tickers on values that change every second
modifiers.note: dense, stable layouts; motion only for state changes the operator must notice

avoid: thin weights and low-contrast muted text
modifiers.note: glare and movement: light mode, strong contrast, 48px targets even on web

avoid: pure white surfaces and bright full-screen flashes
modifiers.note: dark surfaces by default; keep a light option for daytime use

avoid: infinite feeds and streak shaming for minors
modifiers.note: lively but honest: no manipulative engagement loops, privacy defaults on
labels on every control, progressive disclosure, one primary action per screen
critical values and alerts never rely on colour alone and never disappear on their own
